notes.author: claude-fable-review
notes.text: FINDING: injected production Escape did NOT toggle the game menu (run-b step 70 assert-open FAIL), and run-a's protocol 'panel none' close left game-menu assert-closed failing (step 10) — close-request latch or close path not run. The menu itself opens and captures fine via the panel verb (menuOpen=true, run-a). Determine whether the live-input injection path reaches the game-menu toggle before treating ESC behavior as a product gap.
